Needs changes before merge.

The helper stays in the motion tests. It adds no dependency and changes no runtime CAM code. The process declaration is present. No UI files or goldens change.

Local results

I tested the trial merge with upstream main `a277dd9d51e7b4488403b946d0a3234b71ba7504`. The merge had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --no-run`: passed.
- `shape_masks`: 7 passed.
- `trochoid_slot`: 12 passed.
- `adaptive_hsm`: 2 passed; 5 heavy tests stayed ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- I repeated both reported mutations. Skipping three of four trochoid pieces failed with 122 disallowed interior cells. Expanding the Adaptive center region by 2 mm failed with 4112 overcut cells. Each failure wrote its PNG. Both generator tests passed after restoration.

Requested before merge

1. [P2] `crates/motion/tests/common/shape_mask.rs:28`: Clip each ramp to the selected depth before you mark its swept cells. `includes` accepts the whole segment when only its endpoint reaches the selected depth. Line 166 then marks the whole XY capsule. I tested a 6 mm cutter that ramps from `(-7, 0, 0)` to `(7, 0, -4)`. The expected region was the 6 mm wide stadium along that line. Both `AtOrBelow(-4)` and `NearZ { z: -4, tol: 0.001 }` reported all 1792 cells cleared. `assert_bounded_leftover(0.0, None)` passed. The cutter reaches the floor only at the last endpoint, so most of that floor still has stock. Add a regression test for this ramp. Use the actual depth along the segment for the clearance record.

2. [P2] `crates/motion/tests/common/shape_mask.rs:380`: Keep the actual helix depths in the clearance record. A completed descending turn does not clear its whole footprint at `z_end`. This loop records that assumed cut and hides engagement on the next floor pass. I tested a 2 mm cutter on a circle of radius 3 mm. Two CCW half-arcs descend from Z=0 through Z=-2 to Z=-4. Two more half-arcs follow the same circle at Z=-4. With a 0.125 mm cell, the helper reports only 0.034 mm engagement. It accepts a 0.25 mm limit. When I disable only this floor promotion, the same path reports 1.906 mm and fails the 0.438 mm limit with tolerance. Add this regression test. Do not count a floor cut before the cutter makes it.

The two temporary regression tests failed because these errors were not detected. I restored all temporary changes. The seven helper tests and both generator tests passed again. No review evidence was committed.

The full motion gate and the ignored heavy tests were not run during this review. The three suites above are the only suites that import the new helper.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the two review findings in e9f3eb5741b28987e22ba6f065801a40564ed154.

1. Ramp footprints are clipped to the selected depth interval. Clearance records the deepest actual cutter position covering each cell. Pins: `shape_mask_ramp_only_clears_the_selected_depth_interval` and `shape_mask_ramp_does_not_preclear_a_floor_return`.
2. Descending helices no longer promote their whole footprint to the final floor. Pin: `shape_mask_descending_helix_does_not_preclear_its_floor`.

Each isolated mutation failed its pin. Restoring the fixes passed all 10 `shape_masks` tests. Clippy passed for all motion targets.

The existing Adaptive and trochoid generator masks now report engagement that the removed floor promotion hid. Adaptive reports 10.000 mm against a 2.352 mm limit. Trochoid reports 10.000 mm against a 5.375 mm limit. Their assertions and production generators remain unchanged because this fix is limited to the review findings.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` finished RED: 1,030 passed, 2 failed, 53 ignored. The only failures were `adaptive_pocket_shape_mask_holds_shape_and_engagement` and `trochoid_slot_shape_mask_holds_shape_and_engagement`, with the engagement measurements above. No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed.

Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft.

Needs changes before merge.

The two defects from the previous review are fixed. Ramp footprints use the selected depth interval. Descending helices retain their actual depths. The three new regression tests pass.

The changes stay in motion tests and documentation. They add no dependency and change no runtime CAM code. The process declaration is present. No UI files or goldens change.

Local results

I tested the trial merge with upstream main `780b0a25a40606dc3cc96f56ab0b2c8ecb1093e6`. The merge had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test shape_masks`: 10 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test trochoid_slot`: 11 passed; 1 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test adaptive_hsm`: 1 passed; 1 failed; 5 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Requested before merge

1. [P2] `crates/motion/tests/adaptive_hsm.rs:548`: Make the Adaptive mask test pass with a valid engagement model and fixture. The new test fails on the unmodified trial merge:

   ```text
   shape_mask 'adaptive_pocket_mask': engagement exceeded: max cut width 10.000 mm > limit 2.352 mm (stepover 1.977 + 1.5*cell) at Some(Point2 { x: -2.99357676971581, y: -0.19620938769042862 })
   ```

   This failure makes the normal motion suite fail. Check the entry and floor passes against the stated engagement limit. Correct the fixture or the measurement as the geometry requires. Keep the regression that prevents false floor clearance. Do not hide the failure with an ignored test or an unsupported limit increase.

2. [P2] `crates/motion/tests/trochoid_slot.rs:362`: Make the trochoidal mask test pass with a valid engagement model and fixture. This new test also fails on the unmodified trial merge:

   ```text
   shape_mask 'trochoid_slot_mask': engagement exceeded: max cut width 10.000 mm > limit 5.375 mm (stepover 5.000 + 1.5*cell) at Some(Point2 { x: -19.384363742013797, y: -2.891446717414635 })
   ```

   Check why this fixture exceeds its stated half-diameter bound. Keep meaningful checks for engagement, overcut and leftover. The required first users from issue #1768 must pass before this helper can merge.

Mutation checks

I repeated two isolated mutations from the review fixes:

- Removed ramp clipping and kept each full segment. `shape_mask_ramp_only_clears_the_selected_depth_interval` failed at line 80. It passed after restoration.
- Restored the previous completed-helix floor promotion. `shape_mask_descending_helix_does_not_preclear_its_floor` failed at line 137. It passed after restoration.

All 10 helper tests passed again after restoration. I restored all temporary changes. No review evidence was committed.

Notes

Update the PR body with the current test counts and failures. Its green gate report describes the earlier head. Update `docs/decisions/1768-shape-masks.md:15` and its explanation of helix floor promotion to describe the final implementation.

I ran the quick gate plan only. I did not run the full gate or the ignored heavy tests. The three suites above are the only suites that import this helper. Each failing generator test wrote its difference PNG.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Adaptive engagement fixture now starts with an explicit 8 mm radius starter bore cleared to Z=-5. Pin: `adaptive_pocket_shape_mask_holds_shape_and_engagement`. It measures 1.956 mm against the unchanged 2.352 mm limit.
2. Trochoidal engagement fixture now starts with an explicit 8 mm radius starter bore cleared to Z=-6. Pin: `trochoid_slot_shape_mask_holds_shape_and_engagement`. It measures 5.218 mm against the unchanged 5.375 mm limit. Overcut and leftover checks remain.
3. Added `shape_mask_precleared_bore_respects_its_radius_and_depth`. It rejects smaller or shallower bores and overload outside the bore. Initial clearance gives no swept coverage credit. The solid-stock ramp and helix regressions still pass.
4. Updated the decision record to describe actual helix depths and starting stock. Updated the PR body with current counts and results.

Each isolated mutation failed its pin. Each restored pin passed. Quick gate: 1,033 passed, 0 failed, 53 ignored. Motion all-target clippy passed with warnings denied. No screenshots, logs or review evidence were committed.

New head: 85de93b9202e01dbd66f6602530a2a56ad955b1d.

Please re-review. The PR remains a draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 85de93b9202e01dbd66f6602530a2a56ad955b1d -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The earlier findings are resolved. Both generator mask tests now pass with explicit starter bores and the original engagement limits. The helper limits initial clearance by region and depth. Initial clearance gives no swept-path coverage credit. The solid-stock ramp and helix regressions still pass. The PR body and decision record describe the final implementation.

The changes stay in motion tests and documentation. They change no runtime G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. There are no dependency, UI or golden changes. The body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Local results

I tested the trial merge with upstream main `780b0a25a40606dc3cc96f56ab0b2c8ecb1093e6`. The merge had no conflicts. I checked the laws in that main revision. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test shape_masks`: 11 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test trochoid_slot`: 12 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test adaptive_hsm`: 2 passed; 5 heavy tests stayed ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Mutation checks

I ran each mutation separately. Each test failed with the mutation and passed after restoration.

- Disabled initial bore clearance: the bore regression failed at 2.000 mm against a 0.688 mm limit.
- Used solid stock for Adaptive: its generator test failed at 10.000 mm against a 2.352 mm limit.
- Used solid stock for trochoidal milling: its generator test failed at 10.000 mm against a 5.375 mm limit.
- Shifted the generated Adaptive path by 2 mm in X: its test detected 844 overcut cells.
- Skipped three of four trochoidal moves: its test detected 28 disallowed interior cells.

Each mutation failure wrote a difference PNG. I restored all temporary changes and checked that the worktree had no code diff. No review evidence was committed.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: I ran the quick gate plan, not the full gate. The three tested suites are the only suites that import this helper. I did not run the ignored heavy tests or GUI suites. The new checks verify the stated starting stock; they do not certify entry into solid stock. `adaptive_hsm.rs` grows beyond the approximate 400-line guideline. A later test-file split can keep its fixtures easier to read.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
